      public void addObjectTableEntry(HwmfObjectTableEntry entry, int index)
      Adds or sets an record of type HwmfObjectTableEntry to the object table. The index must be > 0
      Parameters:
      entry - the record to be stored
      index - the index to be overwritten, regardless if its content was unset before
